text:
rachel: FYI customers reporting streams pause ~200-400ms mid-response, client interprets as idle and reconnects -> duplicate completions. Happens on both SSE and WS.
tom: any traces? route or tenant patterns?
rachel: traces: trace=ghi789, trace=ghi792. mostly high-concurrency tenants on eu-west. stack shows gateway sending lease-refresh then immediate drain due to backpressure and edge closing.
liam: does this align with recent routing change (sticky->stateless) we rolled last week?
suresh: could be. stateless routing gives short-lived leases; if gateway doesn't ack lease fast enough, edge thinks client is idle and sends EOF. Race: lease-grace window vs proxy idle-timeout.
zoe: console shows stream.idle_disconnects spike at 0.18% vs baseline 0.03% over 6h. panel: https://console/redwood/d/streams?panel=idle_disconnects. top routes: /v1/stream/chat.
ops: current proxy idle timeout for HTTP->SSE is 250ms. gateway lease-grace default is 150ms. mismatch obvious.
billing-bot: note: when duplicate completions occur we currently bill both completions.
rachel: customer impact = confusing truncated UX + double charges for some completions. a customer SaaS team flagged it.
tom: short-term mitigation: increase idle-timeout to 500ms for affected edge pool? cheap toggle. downside: holding sockets and possible resource pressure.
suresh: propose better fix: align lease_grace_ms with proxy_idle_ms + jitter. OR change gateway to send an explicit keepalive/ping before lease refresh to keep connection warm.
liam: also consider server-side dedupe: if same trace id completes twice within 1s, treat as single billing event. ops: feasible?
ops: cheap: canary swap edge pool config streaming.idle_timeout_ms -> 500 for 5% traffic. Monitor socket saturation and latency. Longer fix needs code changes.
zoe: telemetry plan: add span tag lease.handshake_ms and metric stream.lease_race_count when lease refresh occurs within X ms of idle close. Add dashboard tile: lease_race_by_route.
billing-bot: will add billing metric: dedup_candidates_count when completions share trace within 1s. Helps measure how much we'd save.
suresh: for rollout safety, we should make a feature-flag streaming.lease_sync_mode=true|false. Default false. Canary true for subset and tag traces rollout.variant=lease-sync.
rachel: UX debate: silent fixes (increase timeout) will hide problem but reduce customer-visible errors. Visible fix (502 or forcing resume) surfaces but creates error noise. Any preference?
liam: I prefer visibility + canary. If we mask it, we may hide a larger routing bug.
ops: plan: 5% -> 20% -> 80% with auto rollback on socket_wait_queue_depth > 80th pct or 5xx increase > 20%.
zoe: console rollout UX: show canary vs control lanes, add billing_delta widget and trace sample list. We'll annotate timeline with deploy flag.
suresh: longer term: implement explicit streaming keepalive handshake in protocol (frame "lease-ack"), update runtimes to honor and gateway to wait for ack before closing. That avoids timeout dance.
tom: owner requests: ops to run quick canary for timeout bump, suresh to spec lease-ack RFC, zoe for dashboards, liam for billing dedupe spike analysis, rachel to coordinate customer comms.
ops: PR created CH-10055, flag streaming.idle_timeout_ms, canary schedule tomorrow 01:00 UTC, rollback trigger socket_saturation_15m.
rachel: thanks. I'll open incident thread if any enterprise customers escalate. Let's review canary metrics 30m after rollout. :thumbsup:
liam: ack
zoe: ack - will add alerts: lease_race_rate > 0.05% over 10m -> pager to eng-platform-oncall.
suresh: will draft RFC for lease-ack and add trace tags.
billing-bot: billing dedupe guard PR queued.
ops: ack, starting deploy queue.
